title: The Veil of the Sundered Sea
author: Casper Okonkwo
blurb: August Hartwell, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
